lines.beaver: 요즘 화제인 과학 채널 이야기 들었어요?
lines.beaver_en: Have you heard about that popular science channel?
lines.beaver_roman: yojeum hwajein gwahak chaeneol iyagi deureosseoyo?
lines.learner: 네, 인공 비 실험을 생방송으로 보여 준 채널이요.
lines.en: Yes, the channel that showed an artificial rain experiment live.
lines.roman: ne, ingong bi siheomeul saengbangsongeuro boyeo jun chaeneoriyo.

lines.beaver_en: They did a live broadcast too? How was the reaction?

lines.beaver: 접속자가 많았나 봐요. 몇 명쯤 봤어요?
lines.beaver_en: There must have been lots of viewers. About how many watched?
lines.beaver_roman: jeopsokjaga manan na bwayo. myeot myeongjjeum bwasseoyo?
lines.learner: 온라인 접속자가 한때 십만 명이 넘었대요.
lines.en: I heard online viewers once topped 100,000.
lines.roman: ollain jeopsokjaga hanttae simman myeongi neomeotdaeyo.

lines.beaver: 와, 대단하네요. 다시 볼 수도 있어요?
lines.beaver_en: Wow, impressive. Can you watch it again?
lines.beaver_roman: wa, daedanhaneyo. dasi bol sudo isseoyo?
lines.learner: 네, 녹화 영상 재생 수도 계속 늘고 있어요.
lines.en: Yes, replays of the recording keep going up too.
lines.roman: ne, nokwa yeongsang jaesaeng sudo gyesok neulgo isseoyo.

lines.beaver_en: Did the press report on it too?
lines.learner: 네, 여러 미디어가 그 실험을 보도했어요.
lines.en: Yes, many media outlets reported the experiment.
lines.roman: ne, yeoreo midieoga geu siheomeul bodohaesseoyo.

lines.beaver_en: What did the newspaper editorials say?
lines.en: An editorial criticized it as a broadcast just for publicity.

lines.beaver_en: Did users agree with that editorial?
lines.en: No, users pushed back, saying it was scientific.

lines.beaver_en: So the debate grew in cyberspace.
lines.learner: 맞아요. 정보화 시대라서 소식이 빨리 퍼져요.
lines.en: Right. In the information age, news spreads fast.
lines.roman: majayo. jeongbohwa sidaeraseo sosigi ppalli peojyeoyo.

lines.beaver: 그렇네요. 그런 과학 방송은 어떻게 생각해요?
lines.beaver_en: True. What do you think of science shows like that?
lines.beaver_roman: geureonneyo. geureon gwahak bangsongeun eotteoke saenggakaeyo?
lines.learner: 저는 미디어가 과학을 쉽게 알려 줘서 좋아요.
lines.en: I like that media makes science easy to learn.
lines.roman: jeoneun midieoga gwahageul swipge allyeo jwoseo joayo.

lines.beaver_en: Today's talk was really fun. Thanks.
lines.learner: 저도요. 다음에 그 채널 같이 봐요.
lines.en: Me too. Let's watch that channel together next time.
lines.roman: jeodoyo. daeume geu chaeneol gachi bwayo.
